question: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Go on**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stop**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Go on"** means to continue or proceed with an activity or action. (जारी रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** She asked him to go on with his story despite the interruptions.
 
 
• **"Stop"** refers to ceasing or discontinuing an activity or action. It is the antonym of "Go on." (रुकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The bus stopped at the station to let passengers get on.
